biography.value:
Description

A spirit that takes the form of a beautiful woman. It charms beasts and monsters alike with its eerie beauty, It lends them power, but in returns slowly steals their life energy. Monsters which have been granted power by leanan are capable of breaking through powerful seals, so these are the natural foes to those who protect such seals.

Defense

AC 23, touch 18, flat-footed 18 (+3 deflect, +4 dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)

hp 99 [144] (18d6+36)

mp 95

Fort +12, Ref +19, Will +17

DR 10/magic;

Immune critical hits, death effects, poison, sneak attacks, fire;

Strong Ice;

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Slam +9 (1d6 plus burn) or Touch +9 (1d2 Wis damage)

Special Attacks Burn (1d6 fire damage, DC 23), Healing Flame, Mesmerizing Voice

Spells Known (FC CL 18th, Concentration +20)

At will (DC 14) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 15) - fire, sleep (DC 14)

2nd (DC 16) - detonate II, fire II, silence (DC 15)

3rd (DC 17) - Fira, Fire III, Sleepga (DC 17)

4th (DC 18) - Comet, Fire IV, Silencega (DC 18)

5th (DC 19) - Burn, Firaga, Sleepja (DC 18)

6th (DC 20) - Blazing Winds, Flare, Silenceja (DC 19)

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 19, Con 14, Int 18, Wis 15, Cha 16

Base Atk +9; CMB +9; CMD 23

Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dodge, Elemental Focus (fire), Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Greater Elemental Focus (fire), Silent Spell, Spell Penetration

Skills Acrobatics +20, Bluff +20, Escape Artist +20, Knowledge (arcana) +20, Knowledge (local) +20, Knowledge (nature) +20, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Spellcraft +20, Stealth +20

Languages Aquan, Sylvan, Undercommon

SQ Liquid Form

description.value: A leanan deals fire damage in addition to damage dealt on a successful hit in melee. Those affected by the burn ability must also succeed on a Reflex save or catch fire, taking the listed damage for an additional 1d4 rounds at the start of its turn. A burning creature can attempt a new save as a full-round action. Dropping and rolling on the ground grants a +4 bonus on this save. Creatures that hit a burning creature with natural weapons or unarmed attacks take fire damage as though hit by the burning creature and must make a Reflex save to avoid catching on fire.

The burning creature can use a full-round action to attempt a new Reflex save. Dropping and rolling gives +4.

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, Leanan manifests a scared flame beneath her foe up to 30 feet away, dealing 6d6 points of damage (half holy/fire) and heals herself for half the damage dealt. The target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 23) to take half damage and Leanan does not gain any hit points. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).

save.description: Half damage and no healing; otherwise heal half the damage actually dealt.

effect: Split one roll equally between fire and holy. On failure regain half damage actually dealt. Success: half damage, no healing.

description.value: All creatures within a 30-foot radius from leanan must make a DC 23 Will save or have their fire resistance dropped by 10 for 1d4 rounds. Whether or not the save is successful, that creature cannot be affected again by the same leanan's lava dome ability for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

description.value: A leanan is always in liquid-lava form. She gains immunity to critical hits, poison, and sneak attacks. She also has DR/10 magic. She retains her own base speed.

Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, Leanan sings a mesmerizing song that charms all those nearby her. Creatures within 30 feet of leanan must make a Will save (DC 23) or be charmed for 1 minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).
